performance_case.causal_mechanism: One deterministic transitive test of both design lanes detects incompatible seals, selected-tier drift, route drift and create-once interface gaps before the first real R1 outcome reaches Local execution.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This slice can prove only offline temporary-root pipeline compatibility and test coverage. Real fixed-root execution, prediction, fees, slippage, fills, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS, PnL, drawdown and Trading usefulness remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. No drawdown improvement may be inferred until a later preregistered matched-capital strategy experiment passes Validation and sealed OOS gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Leaving the positive-route V4 lane outside the end-to-end regression can defer a hash or route-binding failure until after fourteen forward days, wasting evidence latency and operator attention; broad orchestration code would add unjustified complexity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The test cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but closing the only untested post-interpretation design lane should reduce time from a valid R1 result to a credible accept-or-reject economic research decision.
